description: This file defines an object 'CanvasActionTrust' that provides functions to verify if a URL is trusted for canvas actions within an Android app, with utility functions for normalization and comparison of URIs.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted based on predefined trusted URLs and internal rules.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Determines whether a candidate URI exactly matches a trusted URI after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI for comparison, normalizing scheme/host and ignoring fragments, aligned with iOS normalization.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a URI object, returning null on failure.
